macro_events.name: RBI Monetary Policy Meeting
macro_events.rule: Avoid taking new directional breakout trades 30 minutes before and 20 minutes after RBI rate decision. Expect violent two-sided wicks that sweep retail stop-losses.

macro_events.name: US Federal Reserve FOMC Rate Decision & Presser
macro_events.rule: Algorithmic stop hunting runs 50-100 pips in both directions. Hold zero intraday leverage; wait for 15-minute candle to close outside initial knee-jerk range.

macro_events.name: US Consumer Price Index (CPI) Inflation Release
macro_events.rule: Spreads widen exponentially on Indices, Gold, and Forex. Do not place tight market orders. Wait for the 5-minute candle close after release.

macro_events.name: Nifty/BankNifty Weekly Expiry Afternoon Gamma Move
macro_events.rule: Option seller stop runs frequently produce sharp counter-trend traps or massive 0-hero gamma moves. Scalp only with strict system trailing stops.

macro_events.name: Market Opening Flurry (First 15 Minutes)
macro_events.typical_window: 9:15 AM - 9:30 AM IST / 9:30 AM - 9:45 AM EST
macro_events.rule: Retail overnight orders execute at open creating artificial wicks and price extremes. Wait for 15-minute initial balance to form.

session_rules.asian_session: Range bound, builds liquidity on both sides (Asian high/low).
session_rules.london_open: Known for 'Judas Swing' - fake run opposite to true daily trend to sweep Asian liquidity.
session_rules.ny_session: High volume trend expansion; overlaps with London session between 6:30 PM - 9:30 PM IST.
